evidence.text: Fifth-force limits are converted from Yukawa-potential strengths using material lepton charges. Stellar bounds use emission and trapping recasts; BBN bounds use expansion and neutrino-annihilation rates for selected extra-radiation limits ΔNν = 0.5, 1, 1.5.

sources.title: Inferring the covariant $\Theta$-exact noncommutative coupling in the top quark pair production at linear colliders

evidence.text: Hybrid Θ-exact SW maps generate gauge-covariant vertices. The analysis computes photon, Z and interference contributions, then uses helicity projectors to resolve initial and final spin configurations.

evidence.text: The authors sample 2 million log-uniform parameter sets and impose collider, Z-decay and ALP-lifetime constraints. Scan ranges include ma = 0.001–2 GeV, mN = 10⁻⁹–1 GeV, mS = 0.5–2 TeV and Λ = 1–100 TeV; charged-lepton coefficients are equated.

sources.title: $Z'$s and sterile neutrinos from heterotic string models: exploring $Z'$ mass exclusion limits

evidence.text: Mass matrices are diagonalized for neutral gauge bosons, CP-even/odd and charged scalars, and a five-state neutrino system. Gauge and fermion rotations determine the Z′ vector/axial neutrino couplings; tree-level partial widths are combined into a total decay rate.

sources.title: Precision studies for string derived $Z'$ dynamics at the LHC

evidence.text: Calculate differential Drell–Yan observables at NNLO QCD using an amended MCFM-v9.0 implementation containing the model charges, Z′ contribution and interference. The authors report agreement within 1% against DY-Turbo and FEWZ; this pass does not independently validate that comparison.

sources.title: TeV window to grand unification: The Higgs boson’s light color triplet partner

evidence.text: Use approximate seesaw diagonalization to express active–sterile mixing through mass eigenvalues, then compare T-mediated proton-decay amplitudes with neutron–sterile mixing amplitudes. Collider lifetimes and disappearance times are estimated at order of magnitude.

sources.title: Gravitational Atoms

evidence.text: Boltzmann equations describe formation and decay; comoving yields and cosmological redshifting determine the present graviton spectrum. PIDM production uses detailed balance. Direct SM+SM→B production differs from dilute-X radiative capture, which requires external graviton emission.

sources.title: Dynamical chameleon neutron stars: Stability, radial oscillations, and scalar radiation in spherical symmetry

evidence.text: Extract radial frequencies from central-density power spectra. Reconstruct scalar strain from the Jordan-frame Newman–Penrose scalar or hs ≃ 2α0(φ−φ∞), then integrate against detector noise spectra for SNR. Detector estimates assume optimal scalar orientation F0 = 1/2.

sources.title: The environment dependent dilaton in the laboratory and the solar system

evidence.text: Use Binet's equation and a revolving-orbit angular rescaling, expand a general central force about a nearly circular orbit, and linearize in the added force. The output isolates the combination of force and radial derivative probed by lunar perigee motion.

sources.title: Gravitational Atoms

evidence.text: Bound-state production amplitudes are constructed by integrating free-particle amplitudes against momentum-space Schrödinger wavefunctions. At leading nonrelativistic order, the ground-state amplitude reduces to the free amplitude at rest multiplied by ψ(0)/√mX; time reversal supplies annihilation rates.

sources.title: Dynamical chameleon neutron stars: Stability, radial oscillations, and scalar radiation in spherical symmetry

evidence.text: Use an Einstein-frame spherical Z3 evolution system with 1+log slicing, HRSC finite differences, adaptive dissipation, and third-order SSP Runge–Kutta time integration at Courant factor 0.25. The authors report resolution convergence and outer-boundary robustness.

sources.title: Dynamical chameleon neutron stars: Stability, radial oscillations, and scalar radiation in spherical symmetry

evidence.text: Construct initial stars by integrating modified TOV equations outward and shooting to Schwarzschild–de Sitter asymptotics. Transform static areal coordinates to maximal isotropic coordinates for evolution.
